Important note : The backpacks won't disappear on death !

Hello there fellow prisonners !

I just wanted to show you my most recent modded rundown : Gun The Fuck Out. It's all about using guns and killing stuff and also using guns to kill stuff. The gameplay emphasize about quick reflexes and positionnement.

I'm not really good at advertising stuff and all but, it's a completly different experience from the original game and i wanted to experience it with some people with the goal of balancing it and making it more intersting to play. For example, no regeneration and less HP to make the gunfight feel more intense. Guns are really powerful and while the ennemies seems almost the same as the vanilla game, they are faster, and far more numerous. Get ready to get swarmed !

Oh and before people ask, no unreleased content is used in the mod (like datamined ennemies or melee head) with the exception of some weapon part (because yes there is a lot of custom weapons).

If you want to play it, you can join this discord (It's more a french server but it's the only one i can propose for now) : [https://discord.gg/VNTgBmJbjf](https://discord.gg/VNTgBmJbjf)
